sentences.en: The aristocrat clings to the glory of his past.
sentences.zh: 这位贵族仍固守着过去的荣耀。

sentences.en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
sentences.zh: 贵族们住在皇宫东边和西边。

sentences.en: "The Aristocrats" is one of the world's bluest jokes.
sentences.zh: "贵族们"是世界上最不正经的笑话之一。

senses.zh: 贵族,贵族政治论者,有贵族派头的人
